
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/tianqing/p/19622970" title="发布于 2026-02-18 11:20">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">.NET 10 &amp; C# 14 New Features 新增功能介绍-扩展成员Extension Members</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p class="p1"><span class="s1">C# 14 引入了对扩展成员（Extension Members）的增强支持，本质上是对传统“扩展方法”模型的一次语言级升级，使其可以定义的不再仅限于方法，</span></p>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1">而是可以扩展更多成员形态（例如属性、运算符等）。</span></p>
<p class="p1"><strong><span class="s1" style="font-size: 16px">一、从扩展方法到扩展成员</span></strong></p>
<p class="p1">早在 <a><span class="s1">C# 3.0</span></a> 中，就引入了“扩展方法（Extension Methods）”，其底层机制是：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1">必须定义在 static class</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">方法必须是 <span class="s1">static</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">第一个参数使用 <span class="s1">this T</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> StringExtensions
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> IsNullOrEmptyEx(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> value)
        </span>=&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.IsNullOrEmpty(value);
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>从本质上看：</p>
<blockquote>编译器在语法层面做“糖化处理”，最终仍然是静态方法调用。</blockquote>
<p><span class="s1">LINQ就是最大的应用场景。</span></p>
<p><strong><span class="s1" style="font-size: 16px">二、C# 14中引入扩展成员和示例说明</span></strong></p>
<p class="p1">C# 14 允许在更自然的语法结构中声明扩展成员，不再局限于“静态类 + this 参数”模式，而是支持类似：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Enumerable
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Extension block</span>
    extension&lt;TSource&gt;(IEnumerable&lt;TSource&gt; source) <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> extension members for IEnumerable&lt;TSource&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Extension property:</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> IsEmpty =&gt; !<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">source.Any();

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Extension method:</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> IEnumerable&lt;TSource&gt; Where(Func&lt;TSource, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span>&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> predicate) { ... }
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> extension block, with a receiver type only</span>
    extension&lt;TSource&gt;(IEnumerable&lt;TSource&gt;) <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> static extension members for IEnumerable&lt;Source&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> static extension method:</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> IEnumerable&lt;TSource&gt; Combine(IEnumerable&lt;TSource&gt; first, IEnumerable&lt;TSource&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> second) { ... }

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> static extension property:</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> IEnumerable&lt;TSource&gt; Identity =&gt; Enumerable.Empty&lt;TSource&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> static user defined operator:</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> IEnumerable&lt;TSource&gt; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">operator</span> + (IEnumerable&lt;TSource&gt; left, IEnumerable&lt;TSource&gt; right) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> left.Concat(right);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1">定义的是一个 extension block<span class="s1">，目标类型是：IEnumerable&lt;TSource&gt;</span></span></p>
<p class="p1">代码分成两类 extension block：　　</p>
<ol start="1">
<li>
<p class="p1"><strong>实例扩展成员</strong></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1"><strong>静态扩展成员</strong></p>
</li>
</ol>
<p>① 实例扩展成员：extension&lt;TSource&gt;(IEnumerable&lt;TSource&gt; source)&nbsp;</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1">source 是接收者（receiver）</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1">类似旧语法的 this IEnumerable&lt;TSource&gt; source</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">但语法更接近真正“为类型添加成员”</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;扩展属性：public bool IsEmpty =&gt; !source.Any();</p>
<p class="p1">&nbsp;编译器会生成：public static bool get_IsEmpty&lt;TSource&gt;(IEnumerable&lt;TSource&gt; source)</p>
<p class="p1">&nbsp;代码调用：list.IsEmpty</p>
<p class="p1">&nbsp;会被编译为：Enumerable.get_IsEmpty(list)</p>
<p class="p1">&nbsp;其本质仍然是：</p>
<blockquote>静态方法 + 语法糖绑定</blockquote>
<p class="p1">但在语义层面：它已经不再是“工具方法”，而是“类型能力”。</p>
<p class="p1">扩展方法：public IEnumerable&lt;TSource&gt; Where(Func&lt;TSource, bool&gt; predicate)</p>
<p class="p1">即增强原有LINQ的Where功能</p>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1">如果系统中已有 System.Linq.Enumerable.Where<span class="s1">：</span></span></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="p1">实例成员优先</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">然后才是 extension block</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">再是 using 引入的扩展方法</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;不会破坏已有 API，只是参与候选集。</p>
<p class="p1">② 静态扩展成员</p>
<p class="p1">extension&lt;TSource&gt;(IEnumerable&lt;TSource&gt;)</p>
<p class="p1">这里没有 receiver 变量名。</p>
<blockquote>为类型本身添加“静态扩展成员”</blockquote>
<p class="p1">找一个静态扩展方法</p>
<p class="p1">public static IEnumerable&lt;TSource&gt; Combine(...)</p>
<p class="p1">代码调用：IEnumerable&lt;int&gt;.Combine(a, b);</p>
<p class="p1">编译器会转化为：Enumerable.Combine(a, b);</p>
<p class="p1">再看一个静态扩展属性</p>
<p class="p1">public static IEnumerable&lt;TSource&gt; Identity</p>
<p class="p1">代码调用：IEnumerable&lt;int&gt;.Identity</p>
<p class="p1">这在旧扩展方法体系中是无法表达的。</p>
<p class="p1">再看一个扩展运算符</p>
<p class="p1">public static IEnumerable&lt;TSource&gt; operator +</p>
<p class="p1">这是 C# 14 的重大增强点。现在你可以写：</p>
<p class="p1">var result = list1 + list2;</p>
<p class="p1">等价于：Enumerable.op_Addition(list1, list2);</p>
<p class="p1"><strong><span style="font-size: 16px">三、底层编译机制</span></strong></p>
<p class="p1">&nbsp;<strong>不修改 CLR 元数据</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="p1"><span class="s1">不改变 IEnumerable&lt;T&gt;</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">不增加真实成员</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;<strong>IL 仍然是静态方法</strong></p>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp;所有成员都会生成：&nbsp;public static ...</p>
<p class="p1">&nbsp;<strong>语义绑定由编译器完成</strong></p>
<p class="p1">扩展成员解析规则：</p>
<ol start="1">
<li>
<p class="p1">实例真实成员</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">同 namespace extension block</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">using 导入 extension block</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p>&nbsp;<strong><span style="font-size: 16px">四、与传统扩展方法对比</span></strong></p>
<p>&nbsp; &nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/23525/202602/23525-20260218111804828-477864692.png" alt="image" width="657" height="246" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>同时，零运行时开销。</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="p1">无反射</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">无动态代理</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">无装饰器</p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="p1">无运行时注入</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;完全编译期绑定。</p>
<blockquote>编译器级语义增强，不改变运行时类型结构。</blockquote>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;以上分享给大家。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>周国庆</p>
